cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Graduation Rates**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Ready-made 150% graduation rates.** Derived rates for first-time, full-time students at 4-year and 2-year institutions, with race/ethnicity and gender breakdowns and transfer-out rates.
- **Underlying 150% cohort counts.** Cohort and completer counts for 4-year and 2-year institutions, including bachelor's-seeking and other students, transfer-outs, and gender and race/ethnicity detail.
- **Less-than-2-year institutions.** Cohort counts, exclusions, completers and transfer-outs, plus students still enrolled or no longer enrolled, for less-than-2-year institutions.
- **Longer 200% completion windows.** Completion within 100, 150 or 200 percent of normal time: bachelor's degrees at 4-year institutions, any degree or certificate at less-than-4-year ones.
- **Gender-unknown cohort counts.** Counts of students with unknown or another gender in revised cohorts. This table has no completion information.
- **Pell and Stafford loan subcohorts.** Graduation data for Pell recipients, subsidized Stafford loan recipients, and students with neither, at 4-year and 2-year institutions, in the earlier loan-label series.
- **Pell and Direct Subsidized subcohorts.** The same kind of aid-group graduation data, labeled Direct Subsidized Loan, for 4-year and 2-year institutions in the later loan-label series.

**Survey: Outcome Measures**

Outcome dates: August 31, 2016.

- **Award and enrollment rates.** Award rates at 6 and 8 years, plus still-enrolled and enrolled-elsewhere rates, for full-time and part-time, first-time and non-first-time undergraduates at degree-granting institutions.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Entering cohorts and outcome dates are different; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources. Loan-program labels differ across years; equivalence between those source series is not assumed. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details.

cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Human Resources**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Full-time instructional staff by rank.** Counts of full-time instructional staff by academic rank, faculty status and tenure status, for degree-granting institutions.
- **Instructional staff by race and gender.** Full-time instructional staff counts by faculty and tenure status, rank, race/ethnicity and gender, for degree-granting institutions.
- **Staff counts by occupation and tenure.** Staff counts by occupational category and faculty and tenure status, split by full- or part-time and medical school status where applicable.
- **Instructional staff numbers and salary outlays.** Full-time nonmedical instructional staff counts and salary outlays by gender and academic rank, including months-worked categories.
- **New hires by occupation and demographics.** Full-time new hires by occupation, race/ethnicity and gender, with faculty and tenure status for instructional staff, for degree-granting institutions.
- **Noninstructional staff numbers and outlays.** Full-time nonmedical noninstructional staff counts and salary outlays by occupational category.
- **Derived salary and staffing variables.** Ready-made average salaries equated to nine months for full-time nonmedical instructional staff by rank, plus full-time-equivalent staff by occupation.

**Survey: Fall Enrollment**

Reporting periods: Fall 2015 through Fall 2024.

- **Student-to-faculty ratio and entering class.** Student-to-faculty ratio alongside entering class size and first-year retention, for institutions with undergraduate students.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details.

cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Finance**

Reporting periods: Fiscal year 2015 through Fiscal year 2024.

- **Institution spending by function.** Finance indicators cover core expenses by category, shares of total expenses, and expenses per full-time equivalent student. Separate indicator sets exist for different accounting standards.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Vocational program student charges.** Charges for programs measured in clock hours or mainly occupational programs, including price of attendance with an other-expenses estimate for the largest program.
- **Academic year student charges.** Full academic year charges, including tuition and fees and price of attendance for full-time, first-time undergraduates, with other-expenses estimates.
- **Branch campus cost of attendance.** Branch campus locations listed in the college search tool, with cost of attendance for branches enrolling full-time, first-time undergraduates. The list is not comprehensive.

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Cost of attendance and student charges.** Application fees, tuition, food and housing for undergraduate and graduate students, plus cost of attendance estimates for first-time, full-time undergraduates.

**Survey: Academic Libraries**

Reporting periods: 2015-16; 2016-17; 2017-18; 2019-20; Fiscal year 2020; Fiscal year 2021; Fiscal year 2022; Fiscal year 2023; Fiscal year 2024.

- **Library expense distribution.** Library indicators include the percent distribution of library expenses by function and total library spending per full-time equivalent student, alongside collection mix.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Directory information for institutions.** Look up names, locations, website links, sector, control and level, and Carnegie classifications. Active status is also flagged in this directory.
- **Mission statements, first series.** Find each institution's mission statement text or a web address pointing to it, in one group of years.
- **Mission statements, second series.** A separate mission statement table gives the statement or a web link to it for one year.
- **Mission statements, third series.** Another separate mission statement table gives the statement or its web address for one year.
- **Mission statements, fourth series.** One more mission statement table offers the statement or a link to it for a single year.
- **Mission statements, fifth series.** A further mission statement table provides the statement or its web address for one year.
- **Mission statements, sixth series.** Another mission statement table lists the statement or a web link for one year.
- **Mission statements, seventh series.** The latest mission statement table gives the statement or a web address for one year.

cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Academic Libraries**

Reporting periods: 2015-16; 2016-17; 2017-18; 2019-20; Fiscal year 2020; Fiscal year 2021; Fiscal year 2022; Fiscal year 2023; Fiscal year 2024.

- **Library characteristics, collections and services.** Covers library characteristics, collections, expenditures and services for degree-granting institutions. Expenditure data apply to those with higher total expenditures.
- **Library collection and spending indicators.** Derived indicators show how the collection splits by material type, how expenses split by function, and library spending per full-time-equivalent enrollment.

**Survey: Human Resources**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Instructional staff pay by rank and gender.** Counts and salary outlays for full-time nonmedical instructional staff, by academic rank and gender, with months-worked categories.
- **Noninstructional staff, including librarians.** Counts and salary outlays for full-time nonmedical noninstructional staff by occupation, including a librarian-related category.
- **Instructional staff by rank and tenure.** Counts of full-time instructional staff by academic rank, faculty and tenure status at degree-granting institutions.
- **Instructional staff by race and gender.** Counts of full-time instructional staff by faculty and tenure status, rank, race/ethnicity and gender at degree-granting institutions.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2015-16 through Academic year 2023-24.

- **Academic-year student charges.** Tuition, required fees and per credit hour charges for a full academic year, for institutions reporting academic-year charges.

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Total cost of attendance.** Derived total cost for full-time, first-time degree-seeking undergraduates, by residency and housing plan, for institutions charging by academic year.
